record: The biome game in a browser: docs/BIOME_GAMEPLAY.md §6
pass: the page asking about a place on the land is told what would come: "Mesquite prairie a quarter mile west of the house. Poor ground: a long wait for anything to come. Deer, mustangs, antelope, javelina and turkey keep to it. Waiting here, a mustang: five food, all one can carry, and the hide."
the shot is asked about the place's quarry, "Alvin Proofwright is downwind of a mustang, with a shot to take. It is not a close one.", and no deer is drawn for it

the family is told what was brought down: "Alvin Proofwright brought down a mustang: 5 food came home, and the hide. The rest, 9 food, was more than Alvin Proofwright could carry and was left where it fell."
the family panel offers "Fetch logs from the timber": "Costs the ox and wagon for about 2 hours, to the timber on Dry Fork, beside the house.", its glyph painted
a cleared plot says how its fence would go up: "Ten acres of prairie beside the house, cleared, with no fence. Rails split from the timber at hand: about 3 hours."
no page errors anywhere in the run

fetchLogs.name: Fetch logs from the timber
fetchLogs.note: Costs the ox and wagon for about 2 hours, to the timber on Dry Fork, beside the house.
fetchLogs.summary: Take the ox and wagon to the nearest timber, off your land if need be, and bring six logs home.

fence: Ten acres of prairie beside the house, cleared, with no fence. Rails split from the timber at hand: about 3 hours.
